04 — Experiences & Achievements

Experiences that challenged me and stayed with me.

Some of my most meaningful achievements came from combining curiosity, academic work and experiences outside the classroom.

Sicily · Italy

Climbing Mount Etna

One of my most memorable experiences was climbing Mount Etna in Sicily with my classmates and professors during my studies in Italy. The hike challenged me physically and became a meaningful example of teamwork, curiosity and stepping outside my comfort zone.

Shared experience

Etna with my friends

The experience was especially meaningful because I shared it with people I studied and explored Italy with.

2nd
School project competition

Jazz History & Emotional Well-Being

In 10th grade, I created and presented a research project on the history of jazz and its influence on a person’s emotional state. The project won second place in my school’s project competition.
